title: Photo 075 · 아워글래스 SSBBW · 마키에 · 선 자세 정면 · 라틴 40대 후반
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph on a plain seamless deep-charcoal backdrop, nothing else in the frame, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side so the texture of the skin stands out, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Latina woman in her late 40s, faint lines at the eyes and mouth, warm golden-tan skin tone with olive undertones, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, a wide round afro with a gold headband, a calm confident expression, real living eyes. She wears heavy chandelier earrings and has squared-off coffin nails.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person, her body so wide that her hips are cut off by the left and right edges of the frame. A colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size — a shadowed groove running around her middle, the one place on her body where the outline pulls inward. Below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle, so much of it that it hangs far lower than it projects — sagging down over the tops of her thighs under its own weight rather than pushing forward, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds stacked one above the other as it falls, each fold thicker than the one above it, deep shadowed creases between them, the surface soft and uneven, never taut, never smooth, never round like a drum. It merges seamlessly into her sides, her hips and her thighs with no boundary anywhere, one continuous body rather than a separate mass, not pregnant. Enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline and far wider than her shoulders, a gigantic rounded rear, gigantic soft thighs pressing together down to the knees, huge soft calves, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body and her hands look small against her thighs. Wide at the bust, drawn in at the waistline, wide again below: the silhouette reads as a great hourglass at the most extreme size. Every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other. The flesh is softer and looser at this age, each fold hanging lower and settling further over the one below it. The sheer weight of the flesh is visible in how every part hangs, settles and presses against the part below it.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a coarser surface grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, crepey texture in the deepest folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, the raking light picking out every ridge and hollow of the surface. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Japanese maki-e lacquer style — glossy black lacquer with sprinkled gold powder shading into flowing autumn grasses, chrysanthemums, plum branches and full moons, bold gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs, a scattered gold-flake ground filling the space between every motif. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge and cracks a little where the skin folds. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: her shoulders, her upper arms, her forearms and the backs of her hands are painted as densely as her torso, and so are the sides of her body, her back, her rear, the lower belly, the knees, the calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.

Pose: Standing square to the camera, full frontal, feet planted far apart, the heavy mass of her middle resting down on her thighs, arms held clear of her body with a visible gap of background between each arm and her side so her whole outline reads unbroken, full body head to toe.

Footwear: Extreme gold peep-toe platform stiletto pumps, the platform soles as tall as her ankle bones, the ultra-thin stiletto heels so high her insteps stand nearly vertical.

Background & Lighting: the gold powder glittering, the hard raking light carving every fold and curve.

Vertical 2:3 portrait-orientation full-body photograph, taller than it is wide.
